scientific_limitations: The result gives injectivity at odd lengths and the exact steps of strict image-cardinality loss at even lengths for synchronous Rule 90 on initially cyclic no-adjacent-one words. It does not give the size of the loss at each step or the general time-t fiber histogram. The finite checker is corroborative, not a proof. Originality is assessed against bounded literature coverage, not certified historical priority.
title: Parity-stable inversion of cyclic Rule 90 on Lucas-constrained inputs
